```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE}

  theme(axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth=0.25)))
```

```{r}
load(file=url("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sarahhp/splicing_thermogenesis/refs/heads/main/03limma/rpkm_rep_for_plotting.RData"))
head(long)
sig = read.delim(file="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sarahhp/splicing_thermogenesis/main/03limma/any_and_all_donor_DGE.tsv")
sig[sig$gene_name == "UCP1",]
filter(sig, gene_name == "UCP1") %>% select(matches("adj.P.Val|logFC"))
```
^ p-values from limma DEG analysis < 1.36 x 10^-5


```{r ucp1}
long = mutate(long, subject=gsub("subject","S", donor))

ggplot(filter(long, gene_name == "UCP1"), 
         aes(x=subject, y=fpkm, fill=condition)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "summary", fun=mean, position=position_dodge2(preserve="single"))  + 
    geom_beeswarm(dodge.width=0.9, cex=1.5) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#1F78B4","#FF7F00"))
ggsave(here(figdir, "UCP1_RNA_expr.pdf"))
```
